svg.aria-label: The first three rungs of the load ladder: ten users at a median of 5.2 milliseconds, fifty users at 4.5 milliseconds, and one hundred users at 4.2 milliseconds. The median gets faster as load rises rather than slower. A CPU bar shows the server at nine per cent of one core, marked no impact. The caption points out that a test which stops here reports a success and has measured an idle machine, and that the median falling as load climbs is a warming effect rather than a capacity result.
svg.text: SMALL LOAD TELLS YOU NOTHING, AND IT IS WHERE MOST TESTS STOP
